prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the channels you need (SEO, paid media, social, content, apps, email, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. A quick plan:

1) Quick questions so I can shortlist good matches
- What are your primary goals? (e.g., increase organic traffic, generate leads, grow app installs, brand awareness)
- Which services do you need? (SEO, PPC/Google Ads, social ads, content, email, CRO, app marketing, web design)
- Monthly budget range (ballpark)?
- Company type and size (startup, SMB, enterprise; B2B or B2C)
- Any industries or competitors you want to match/beat?
- Timeline and KPIs that matter (MQLs, CAC, ROAS, installs, revenue)

2) How I’ll evaluate agencies for you
- Relevant case studies and measurable results
- Client retention and references
- Industry experience and vertical expertise
- Pricing model and minimums
- Team structure, reporting cadence, and tools
- Certifications (Google Partner, Facebook Marketing Partner, etc.)

3) Where to look right away
- Clutch.co, G2, UpCity — client reviews and categories
- Google Partner directory (for PPC specialists)
- LinkedIn and local Bay Area award lists

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll shortlist 3–5 San Francisco agencies that fit your needs, with pros/cons and suggested interview questions. Which services and budget are you working with?
